On a grey Tuesday he found a green bottle wedged between the rocks below the gallery. The cork was sealed with wax. Inside was a single page, written in pencil, the letters careful and slanted. He pinned the note above his stove and polished the lens until it shone.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在薄雾里投下昏黄的光圈，空荡的街道像一条沉睡的河。远处传来环卫车缓慢的轰鸣，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。早餐铺的灯最先亮起，蒸笼冒出第一缕白气，老板揉着面，哈欠连连。便利店的玻璃门前，一个夜班司机买了杯热咖啡，靠在车边望着天空。高楼的窗户大多漆黑，只有零星几盏亮着。天边泛起一线鱼肚白，新的一天正悄悄醒来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of nesting dolls: you open one doll and find a smaller doll, and you keep opening until you reach the tiniest one that does not open.\n- That tiniest doll is the stopping point, and without it the opening would never end."}
